# Hand cursors

`grab-*.rgba` and `grabbing-*.rgba` are open and closed hand cursors by
Abdulkaiz Khatri, from release 2.0.1 of
https://github.com/ful1e5/apple_cursor, under the GPL-3.0 (`LICENSE`):
the `Pan` and `Grabbing` cursors of its Windows set, as raw 8-bit RGBA
at 32, 48, 64 and 96 pixels (two at 32: the smaller drawing, named 24,
suits 24 pixel cursors), with the hotspots their `.cur` files give,
which `hand_cursors.rs` carries.
